All three full packets, including alternate Family3/Patient3, personally examined with main text and every main figure/table. Entire held manuscript read; supplement inventory/access incomplete.
Table1Patient3 female agrees with packet but Figure2square indicates male; do not silently choose an authoritative sex source.

Patient1onset24/evaluation36;Patient2onset22/evaluation47;Patient3onset2/evaluation20. Patients2/3learningdisabilities omitted from packets. No outcome rank files consulted; the article reports an Exomiser variant-filter threshold in its own burden analysis, not this project inference results.
Discussion incorrectly names Patients2/3 for acetylation findings where Methods/Results/Figure3 specify1/2/7. Patient3functional evidence must not be claimed from that sentence.
Figure2conservation panel labels residue316mutantR although table/figure1/prose sayCys316Tyr; case4annotation discrepancy does not change assigned Pro173alleles.
Table1Patient12onset54/evaluation62 differs from prose lateonset62; article cohort range2-60 differs from that isolated prose62. Not silently reconciled.

No evidence of universally lower TUBA4A abundance: western ratios nonsignificant, microtubule-associated isoform ratio rises forP173R/H28R and falls forP173S. Tyrosination rises inall3; acetylation lowerP173R/H28R but notP173S. Mechanism remains nonunique.

Figure3caption30fibroblasts percondition with individual microtubules quantified; normal distribution assumed, not formallytested. Biological donor replication limited; exact statistical test and supplementary methods unavailable.
H28Rfamily includes younger unaffected heterozygous sister; mother negative/father unavailable. VUSgroup cannot be treated as fullypenetrant proven causal despite altered patientfibroblast readouts.

Published source classifies several variantsVUS. 100KGPburden6casevariants includes2notretained;4retainedcases includeVUSp.Asp33Val/p.Leu259Val. Gene association evidence and confirmed diagnostic yield are distinct.
